run_knn_ground_truth: run knn_ground_truth to compute exact nearest neighbors for a dataset using faiss.contrib.exhaustive_search
write_ivecs: write integer vectors to an ivecs file using vecs_io.ivecs_write
create_dataset_deep1b: create a DatasetDeep1B instance from faiss.contrib.datasets with a specified number of vectors
get_queries: get query vectors from a faiss dataset using the get_queries method
iterate_database: iterate over database vectors in batches using the database_iterator method with a batch size
